freshProcessPerCommand: Runner spawns process.execPath separately for each of all33 steps; no shared handler process or shell chain.

exitGuardLedger.reason: Both service-onboarding harnesses explicitly delete all MC_* environment variables, including the diagnostic ledger path. This removes their optional exit-log destination, while the preloaded socket/TLS/DNS guards and their own network-denial fixtures remain active. Their full logs are retained.
